blocking_conditions: ASSUMP_001: Live Canonical R1 provenance not yet submitted to public Rekor
ASSUMP_002: Live Canonical R2 provenance not yet submitted to public Rekor
ASSUMP_003: Exact Live R2 to Live R1 bundle binding pending live submission
ASSUMP_004: Unattended scheduler signing identity not established in local runtime

lifecycle_governance.compromise_procedure: Upon suspected or confirmed identity compromise, operator issues emergency revocation notice, transitions compromise status to COMPROMISED, freezes all anchor admissions, and marks all bundles signed during compromise window as UNTRUSTED.
lifecycle_governance.emergency_suspension_procedure: Any operator or automated monitor detecting anomalous signing activity trips terminal hold fail-closed boundary, setting NATURAL_OBSERVER_ARMING to NOT_AUTHORIZED and terminating run admission.
lifecycle_governance.historical_valid_bundle_treatment: Historical bundles witnessed before verified compromise timestamp remain valid if inclusion proof and Rekor integrated time predate compromise incident; bundles witnessed during or after compromise are rejected.
lifecycle_governance.rotation_procedure: Planned rotation requires updating pinned SAN and OIDC issuer in policy contract, issuing dual-signed transition epoch record, and archiving public key / certificate chain into local immutable trust store. Prior signatures remain valid.
